body:
WHAT
Editing a prompt in the Prompt Lab browser page sends PUT /api/prompt/<id> with the new text. The server writes it as a plain <id>.txt file in the override directory (MAGENTRA_PROMPTS_DIR, settable with --dir, else ~/.magentra/prompts). The engine's prompt registry re-checks that file's mtime at most every 250 ms, so the next turn uses the new text with no restart. Text equal to the default deletes the file; blank text is stored and disables the prompt.

WHY
Prompt tuning would otherwise require rebuilding and restarting the engine for every experiment, and experiments could not be kept apart from the user's global overrides.

WHERE
tools/prompt-lab/server.mjs — arg('dir') sets process.env.MAGENTRA_PROMPTS_DIR before the registry loads; handler for PUT and DELETE on '/api/prompt/<id>' (calls writePromptOverride / clearPromptOverride, then startWatching); engine/protocol/src/prompts.ts — promptsDir(), promptFile(), writePromptOverride(id,text), clearPromptOverride(id), overrideText(id) with CACHE_TTL_MS=250 and mtime check, promptText(id), promptCatalog(), promptTextIfEnabled(), isPromptDisabled().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With MAGENTRA_PROMPTS_DIR set to a temp dir, writePromptOverride(id,'new text\r\n') creates <dir>/<id>.txt containing 'new text\n' (CRLF normalised, one trailing newline) and promptText(id) returns 'new text' immediately.
2. After an override is in force, overwriting the .txt file directly on disk with different text and advancing time past 250 ms (or waiting 300 ms) makes promptText(id) return the new file content without any call to writePromptOverride or a restart.
3. writePromptOverride(id, <exactly the default text>) removes the file if it existed and promptCatalog() reports overridden false; writePromptOverride(id,' ') writes an empty file and promptCatalog() reports overridden true, disabled true, promptTextIfEnabled(id) undefined.
4. Starting server.mjs with --dir <tempdir> makes GET /api/catalog report dir === <tempdir>, and PUT /api/prompt/<id> with a body writes <tempdir>/<id>.txt and answers {id, overridden:true, currentTokens} while ~/.magentra/prompts is untouched.
5. writePromptOverride('no.such.id','x') throws 'unknown prompt id' and creates no file; DELETE /api/prompt/<id> removes the file and returns overridden false.
